profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Aerospace Corporation
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer - Member of Technical Staff
profile.summary:
Hi! I’m a Software Engineer at The Aerospace Corporation, building tech that supports space and national security missions, work that can ultimately help save lives. Previously at Optum, I worked on healthcare systems with the same mission in mind. With a background in full-stack development and a drive to keep learning, I’m here to build meaningful tools that make a difference. 

I’m constantly looking for ways to grow in my career both as a technical contributor and as a potential leader within my field. While my focus remains on driving impactful projects here at The Aerospace Corporation, I enjoy connecting with peers who share a passion for innovation, technical management, and project leadership.

I’m also committed to supporting initiatives in foster care. I’d love to connect, share ideas, or offer a referral if I can help!

Email: anthonyvuong28@yahoo.com

positions.title: Software Engineer - Member of Technical Staff
positions.locationName: El Segundo, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
AI Adoption Lead | Enterprise Innovation (Oct 2025 - Present)
• Led AI Coding Assistant tools rollout to 1,000+ engineers achieving 83% daily adoption, 30% velocity increases, $1M+ productivity gains
• Advised executives on $500K strategy: Conducted 3 pilots (150+ users), analyzed ROI, delivered procurement recommendations
• Built training infrastructure with company-wide curriculum and weekly office hours—87% satisfaction rating
• Established governance framework defining security controls and risk mitigation for mission-critical applications

Product Lead | Defense Analytics Platform (Jun 2025 - Present)
• Led 15-engineer team delivering platform consolidating 200+ assets from 8+ sources
• Achieved 94% workflow time reduction (2-3 weeks → 2 hours) via self-service data browser
• Architected platform replacing 15+ tools: 3D geospatial visualization with real-time satellite tracking, automated workflows (8+ hours saved/run), dashboards enabling analysis in days vs weeks

Lead Software Engineer | Satellite Resource Scheduler (Oct 2025 - Jul 2026)
• Designed auction-based scheduling with credit-constrained bidding for fair allocation across government/commercial providers
• Secured funding demonstrating 400% scalability across 13 use cases with value-based bidding and partial fulfillment
• Built distributed pub/sub architecture (Go/ZMQ) with non-blocking concurrency for decentralized scheduling

Software Engineer | Satellite Threat Analysis (Apr 2025 - Jul 2026)
• Built C++/Python calculator to assess directed energy threats
• Developed 3D visualization suite (Svelte/TypeScript/ECharts) reducing threat assessment from 1-week to 20-min
• Debugged coordinate conversion errors in RF simulation fixing spherical-to-Cartesian bugs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved region resiliency and performance of chatbots by implementing Azure Front Door and Traffic Manager with Terraform to allow global load balancing with performance-based routing and health monitoring. These improvements reduced downtime by 30% and improved latency/response time by 50 milliseconds, which significantly improved user experience and ensured consistent service availability and reliability across multiple regions.
• Optimized infrastructure with a shared Storage Account architecture, resolving storage limit issues for over 500 tenants’ chatbots. This solution improved scalability, data organization, and led to over $2 million in cost savings by eliminating the need for additional Azure storage purchases or complex data migrations.
• Enhanced Next.js applications by optimizing CI/CD deployment with Azure Hybrid Connections, implementing dynamic routing, refining API routes, and fixing UI bugs. These improvements accelerated release cycles and reduced page load time by 20%, driving increased deployment efficiency and enhancing user experience.
• Resolved over 200 SonarQube issues in Java-based applications supporting Medicare Advantage Plans and Electronic Visit Verification. Optimized SQL queries and data transformation processes within these applications, improving the accuracy and efficiency of over 10,000 weekly provider extracts and reports. These enhancements ensured timely, compliant submissions to both both State and federal EVV reporting requirements.
• Automated GitHub Action workflows to provision over 500 Dialogflow chatbots, manage Google Cloud resources, and create dedicated GitHub repositories, reducing setup time by 75% and improving deployment efficiency
• Developed automated unit and integration tests using Cypress, ensuring the stability and functionality of web applications, leading to a 25% reduction in regression bugs and improved overall code quality

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Optimized performance and usability on data architecture features of a large Business Intelligence application responsible for $10M weekly Supply Chain transactions 
• Built and debugged several Angular applications to manage inventory, sales, and other manufacturing-related operations
• Upgraded a complex BI application from old AngularJS into new Angular with TypeScript, RxJS, and Lodash
• Improved Selenium automation tests to sustain over 75% code coverage and trigger automatic rollback in pipelines
• Collaborated with Infor Consumer Products & Engineering teams, completing biweekly scrum sprints that followed Agile development methods such as issue tracking with Jira and rigorous code reviews using GitLab and Git version control
• Maintained cross platform UI features by implementing, testing, and debugging HTML / CSS code

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
• Participated in the Bridge to Work Foster Program, a workforce development initiative under the Independent Living Program (ILP), which matched me with a paid job assignment at the City of Pasadena Records/Mailroom
• Inspected and verified over 200 building permits and licenses, ensuring accuracy before entering data into the city’s database for proper record-keeping
• Organized and Categorized several documents in Records Department, improving workflow and accessibility for staff
• Worked with IT department to resolve account related issues and assisted office with any computer issues when needed

volunteerExperiences.description: At Foster the City, we build strong community networks to support foster families. The need for foster care is urgent, with many families struggling to continue due to a lack of support. Statistics show that 60% of foster families do not take a second placement because it is too challenging. As an Advocate, I create small support networks to assist families throughout their foster care journey.
